# Shiba

> Open-source, self-hosted coding agent in the Devin style. You run it on your own Cloudflare account.

Shiba is AGPL-3.0-only software. One install is single-tenant and account-owned. A person describes a GitHub task, reviews a frozen approval, and only then does a sandbox edit the repo. The dashboard shows progress and a diff. A pull request is optional and needs a GitHub token on the Worker, not in the container.

The project is a prototype. VERIFICATION.md does not record a live cloud coding run that finished inference and opened a real pull request.

## Who it is for

People who want a Devin-style loop (task, plan, sandbox, diff, optional PR) on infrastructure they control.

## What it runs

- Dashboard, Slack, Telegram, Discord, automations, and `/api/v1` (`@shiba/sdk`) can queue work. A human still approves by default.
- Sandbox default is Cloudflare Containers. docker-local and ComputeSDK adapters exist. Egress is deny-by-default.
- Harness code includes OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok, Devin CLI, Cursor, and Antigravity.
- API keys go through Cloudflare AI Gateway BYOK. The container receives a dummy key.
- Claude Code and Codex adapter cards can sign in with a subscription (ChatGPT device code, or a Claude code you paste). Tokens are encrypted with `MODEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY` and attached at egress.
- Gemini, OpenCode, and Grok on that settings page use an API credential. They do not use the same device-code grant.

## Install

Requirements: Node.js 22.13+, pnpm 10+. Docker is required for a real Sandbox container.

```
pnpm install
pnpm shiba dev
```

Cloudflare deploy: `pnpm run bootstrap` (Alchemy). Live stages require Cloudflare Access or another gate.
